comment: Recorded by ServiceControlRuntimeTests.NativeFirmwareVersionVectors; regenerate with OPENBLADE_REGENERATE_NATIVE_FIRMWARE_VERSION_VECTORS set to this directory. A record row is WindowsFirmwareVersionSource.Capture() over its registry values, its video adapter instances (one list per adapter key), its USB4 devices and its touchpad HID collections, as the v91 status codec writes the firmware member. A version row is Version.TryParse and an integer row is Convert.ToInt32 with the invariant culture.
